response.original_title: Marillion – Out Of The Box-Marillion Weekend 2015
response.overview: The Waves and Numbers (often stylized as Waves And Numb3rs) performance was recorded live on March 20, 2015, at the Marillion Weekend in Port Zélande, Netherlands. During this special Friday night show, the band played their 2001 studio album Anoraknophobia in full.
response.title: Marillion – Out Of The Box-Marillion Weekend 2015
